abstract: A case of pure choriocarcinoma of the testis in a 62-year-old male is reported. The patient consulted his family physician with an enlarged but painless right scrotal containment in November, 1980. Initial diagnosis was right hydrocele testis and chronic epididymitis, and he was treated with antibiotics. However, the tumor continued to enlarge. Right high orchiectomy was performed on March, 15, 1981 under the diagnosis of suspected right testicular tumor. The resected specimen was 10 X 7 X 6 cm and elastic hard. The cut surface was dark reddish with hemorrhagic foci. Serial sections of the entire testis were made and their histopathological examinations revealed the tumor to be a classical pure choriocarcinoma of the testis. The plasma beta-HCG level was remarkably elevated, but the alpha-fetoprotein level was normal. Anticancer chemotherapy (CDDP 125 mg, MTX 20 mg, ADM 50 mg, and EDX 500 mg) was performed in eight courses after the operation. Multiple metastatic foci were present in both lungs during the treatment, and his condition gradually deteriorated. Therefore, he was transferred to our hospital. Aggressive anticancer treatment could not be given because of his poor general condition, and he died on May, 16, 1982 of carcinomatosis. The autopsy revealed multiple nodular metastasis of the tumor to bilateral lungs, bilateral adrenal glands and right kidney. There was no metastasis to the lymph nodes. The metastatic lesions, macrospically dark reddish with hemorrhagic foci, were histopathologically pure choriocarcinoma.
abstract_ja: 62歳男性の精巣純粋絨毛癌の1例を報告する。1980年11月に、無痛性で拡大する右陰嚢内腫瘤を主訴に家庭医を受診した。初診時は右水瘤精巣および慢性副睾丸炎と診断され、抗菌薬で治療された。しかし腫瘤は増大し続けた。1981年3月15日、右精巣腫瘍の疑いで右高位精巣摘除術を施行した。切除標本は10×7×6cmで弾性硬であった。割面は暗赤色で出血巣を伴っていた。精巣全体の連続切片を作製し病理組織学的検査を行ったところ、古典的な純粋絨毛癌と診断された。術後の血漿β-hCGは著明に高値であったが、αフェトプロテインは正常であった。術後、CDDP 125mg、MTX 20mg、ADM 50mg、EDX 500mgによる抗癌化学療法を8コース施行した。治療中に両肺に多発転移巣が出現し、全身状態は徐々に悪化した。そのため当院へ転院した。全身状態不良のため積極的な抗癌治療は行えず、1982年5月16日に癌性腹膜炎で死亡した。剖検では、両肺、両副腎、右腎臓への多発結節性転移を認めた。リンパ節転移は認めなかった。転移巣は肉眼的に暗赤色で出血巣を伴い、病理組織学的には純粋絨毛癌であった。
